notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event's first run and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
These missions were available from the start of the event.
These missions were added on December 14, 2017.
